item.title: Meet Kyutai REKI: The 2.4B VLA Model Bringing Efficient Memory to Robot Manipulation
item.description:
Kyutai, with Inria and École des Ponts, has released REKI, a 2.4B vision-language-action model (VLA) for robot manipulation. The REKI vision-language-action model is pretrained only on public data. It also carries a cheap memory of its recent past. On three out-of-distribution benchmarks, only models about twice its size beat it. All weights are live on […]

item.title: DeepSeek Just Released V4.1-Flash-1017, Scores 77.0 on DeepSWE, Opens Search API

item.title: 20 Jev Alternatives: The Decision Models Taking On TypeSafe in 2026
item.description:
TypeSafe launched Jev on September 15, 2026. It is a decision model, not a chatbot. You define the allowed answers, and Jev returns a label, a score or a yes/no probability. In about 4 weeks, at least 20 Jev alternatives shipped. They come from Cloudflare, OpenAI, Perplexity, Liquid AI, AWS’s Strands Labs and independent developers. […]

item.title: StepFun Releases Step 5 Preview Open Weights: 600B MoE, 27B Active, 1M Context
item.description:
StepFun has released Step 5 Preview as open weights. FP8 and BF16 checkpoints are live on Hugging Face and ModelScope. Step 5 Preview is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts model from StepFun built for long-horizon agentic work. It has 600B total parameters, 27B active per token and up to 1M tokens of context. item.title: Perplexity Open-Sources SPACE, a Firecracker MicroVM Sandbox for AI Agents
item.description:
Perplexity has open-sourced SPACE, the sandbox platform behind every task in Perplexity Computer. The Perplexity SPACE sandbox gives each agent task its own Firecracker microVM. Credentials and outbound traffic are controlled from outside that VM. The code ships under Apache 2.0 on GitHub. For teams building coding or browsing agents, this is a production-tested isolation […]

item.title: Liquid AI Releases d1-ultra: A Multimodal Decision Model That Scores 65 on the AA Decision Index
item.description:
Liquid AI released d1-ultra, a text and image decision model that returns calibrated probabilities in 1 forward pass. It scores 65 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index and costs $0.042 per million input tokens.

The post Liquid AI Releases d1-ultra: A Multimodal Decision Model That Scores 65 on the AA Decision Index appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Meta Releases Muse Spark Open: 816B Open-Weight MoE With 1M Context
item.description:
Meta released Muse Spark Open, an 816B-parameter open-weight MoE model with 42B active parameters and a 1M-token context. It leads open models on MCP-Atlas and runs on 2 M5 Ultra Mac Studios.

The post Meta Releases Muse Spark Open: 816B Open-Weight MoE With 1M Context appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120B Open Multimodal Agent Model
item.description:
NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120B-parameter multimodal MoE model with 12B active parameters, 1M-token context and NVFP4 weights that run on 1 DGX Spark, plus 2 Bolt edge models.
